import sys

def fast_pow(x, y, p):
    ans = 1
    now = x % p
    while y:
        if y & 1:
            ans = (ans * now) % p
        now = (now * now) % p
        y >>= 1
    return ans

def init(fac, inv, maxi, p):
    fac[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, maxi + 1):
        fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % p
    inv[maxi] = fast_pow(fac[maxi], p - 2, p)
    for i in range(maxi - 1, -1, -1):
        inv[i] = (inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % p

def lower(x):
    tmp = 1
    while tmp < x:
        tmp <<= 1
    return tmp

def FWT(now, length, p, type_=False):
    T = now[:]
    if type_:
        i = 1
        while i < length:
            for j in range(0, length, i << 1):
                for k in range(j, j + i):
                    T[i + k] -= T[k]
            i <<= 1
    else:
        i = 1
        while i < length:
            for j in range(0, length, i << 1):
                for k in range(j, j + i):
                    T[i + k] += T[k]
            i <<= 1
    for i in range(length):
        now[i] = T[i] % p
        if now[i] < 0:
            now[i] += p

def multi(f, ct, tmp1, tmp2, tmp3, t, p, pp, maxi):
    for j in range(20):
        for i in range(maxi + 1):
            tmp1[j][i] = 0
        for i in range(maxi + 1):
            t[j][i] = 0
    
    for j in range(maxi + 1):
        tmp1[ct[j]][j] = f[j]
    
    for j in range(20):
        FWT(tmp1[j], maxi + 1, p)
    
    for q in range(20):
        for l in range(20):
            if q + l <= 19:
                for s in range(maxi + 1):
                    t[q + l][s] += tmp1[q][s] * tmp2[l][s]
                    if t[q + l][s] >= pp:
                        t[q + l][s] -= pp
    
    for q in range(20):
        for s in range(maxi + 1):
            tmp3[q][s] = int(t[q][s] % p)
    
    for j in range(20):
        FWT(tmp3[j], maxi + 1, p, True)
    
    for j in range(maxi + 1):
        f[j] = tmp3[ct[j]][j]

def multi2(tmp2, t, p, pp, maxi, ct):
    tmp = [[0] * (maxi + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    
    for i in range(20):
        for j in range(maxi + 1):
            t[i][j] = 0
    
    for q in range(20):
        for l in range(20):
            if q + l <= 19:
                for s in range(maxi + 1):
                    t[q + l][s] += tmp2[q][s] * tmp2[l][s]
                    if t[q + l][s] >= pp:
                        t[q + l][s] -= pp
    
    for q in range(20):
        for s in range(maxi + 1):
            tmp[q][s] = int(t[q][s] % p)
    
    for i in range(20):
        FWT(tmp[i], maxi + 1, p, True)
    
    for i in range(20):
        for j in range(maxi + 1):
            tmp2[i][j] = 0
    
    for i in range(maxi + 1):
        tmp2[ct[i]][i] = tmp[ct[i]][i]
    
    for i in range(20):
        FWT(tmp2[i], maxi + 1, p)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    p = int(data[2])
    
    pp = p * p
    
    if n & 1:
        print(fast_pow(k, n, p))
        return
    
    f = [0] * (1 << 19 | 5)
    ct = [0] * (1 << 19 | 5)
    f[0] = 1
    
    maxi = lower(n + 1) - 1
    
    fac = [0] * (maxi + 1)
    inv = [0] * (maxi + 1)
    init(fac, inv, maxi, p)
    
    for i in range(maxi + 1):
        ct[i] = bin(i).count('1')
    
    tmp2 = [[0] * (maxi + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    for i in range(maxi + 1):
        tmp2[ct[i]][i] = inv[i]
    
    for i in range(20):
        FWT(tmp2[i], maxi + 1, p)
    
    res_k = k
    
    while k:
        if k & 1:
            tmp1 = [[0] * (maxi + 1) for _ in range(20)]
            tmp3 = [[0] * (maxi + 1) for _ in range(20)]
            t = [[0] * (maxi + 1) for _ in range(20)]
            multi(f, ct, tmp1, tmp2, tmp3, t, p, pp, maxi)
        
        k >>= 1
        if k:
            tmp = [[0] * (maxi + 1) for _ in range(20)]
            t = [[0] * (maxi + 1) for _ in range(20)]
            multi2(tmp2, t, p, pp, maxi, ct)
    
    result = (fast_pow(res_k, n, p) - (fac[n] * f[n]) % p + p) % p
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
